content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The stdin clause adds an input stream to a crossing while keeping the status, raw stdout and stderr result, and the runner's two-field state; the license check reads the process boundary, explicitness, statelessness, and the evidence-carrying failure shape, and names any element the rule contradicts. Review form: the criterion is applied to the rule's text; nothing runs.
